reasoning: I reviewed the genuine claim at its own hash. It differs from the planted control only in the three section 2 first_end dates, which are now 1966-08-05. That is the signing date ('August 5,1966'; FR Doc. 66-8711 filed Aug. 8, 1966; 31 FR 10603), and it agrees with the claim's judgment_reason and rationale, which state the filing-date alternative. All quoted spans re-hash and match. Identity and the five-clause inventory (sec. 1, sec. 2 lead-in, 2(1) EO 7856, 2(2) EO 8820, sec. 3) are complete; the recital is not a command. Section 2's 'are hereby superseded' operates on issuance, and the order has no later effective date, so recording performance on the signing date is correct. Sections 1 and 3 continue. The number search shows only citing documents: EO 14348 sec. 3(d) (2025), FR notices 2017-25441, 2018-03801 and 2026-17655, and 22 CFR parts 22 and 51. The OFR note ('Provisionally supersedes: EO 7856; EO 8820 | See: 55 FR 3676; EO 14348') is addressed. 55 FR 3676 is not held. The claim calls it a see-reference that does not end the order. That is supported because an OFR 'See:' pointer is not a disposition and the 2025 order and 2026 notice still rely on the delegation. The 22 U.S.C. 211a note prints the order in force. The savings state continuing_independent fits section 3, and the claim discloses the limit on individual saved rules.
